purpose: same-problem alternative-method learning; choose by structure, data and validation burden rather than prestige

Q1.S001: streaming turning-point/RRF-style online fatigue with temporary damage handling and time correction
Q1.selection_rule: Prefer an explicitly stateful online algorithm if exact incremental semantics matter; prefer a windowed approximation only after window-size sensitivity and exact-rainflow error are quantified.

Q2.S002: physics-derived variables + BiLSTM, compared with Nelder-Mead
Q2.selection_rule: Start with the lowest-complexity causal physics/residual baseline. Upgrade to sequence networks only if chronological holdout shows material improvement and lag structure requires it.

Q3.S001: DDPG learned continuous allocation + safety layer
Q3.selection_rule: Use NSGA-II/solver on reduced instances as an interpretable optimization benchmark; use learned policy only when repeated online solves are too slow and policy feasibility can be guaranteed/tested.

Q4.S001: communication anomaly prediction + robust/min-max style optimization
Q4.S002: SVD denoise + phase-delay detection + spline reconstruction + rerun optimizer
Q4.selection_rule: First identify whether corruption is missingness, delay, or additive noise. Evaluate detector/reconstructor independently before embedding in a robust optimizer.

shared_failure_checks: error propagation from Q2 surrogate into Q1/Q3 objective

figure_design_contrast.S001: fewer, more targeted per-object/per-method figures in the reviewed core
figure_design_contrast.S002: 63 main figures with extensive repeated scenario evidence
figure_design_contrast.lesson: figure count is not a quality target; preserve distinct evidence roles and consolidate repeated scenario-metric plots.
